tasks.title: E04 in full from its design
tasks.brief: You are the only coder on epic E04 (Guided complaint intake). Implement it in full from its design docs/tdd/E04.md: every section, and every R, V and D of its acceptance matrix with a test, including end to end tests on the real stack. docs/build/E04/PLAN.md and ticket_tasks in docs/build/E04/tasks.json describe one split of this work with briefs, tests and gates: use them as a guide and checklist; the design and docs/SYSTEM.md win where they differ. Build in this order: domain, application, adapters, api, user interface, and run your tests as you go. If an epic you depend on has no code yet, code against its port protocol and the kernel fakes (docs/SYSTEM.md section 10).

ticket_tasks.title: Deterministic intake policy, validated catalog and family capture evidence
ticket_tasks.brief:
Read AGENTS.md, docs/SYSTEM.md and docs/requests/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md Part A first, in that order, then every reads entry. Implement only owned_paths. E04's design is frozen. SYSTEM and Part A win, then unresolved review findings; follow the explicit dispositions in docs/build/E04/PLAN.md. At planning time hub/, ui/, eval/ and generated contracts are absent; config/ and contracts/ contain only pharmacy files. Recheck before creating files and preserve concurrent work. Never create another epic's module, edit a shared manifest, contract, configuration, request, design, review or AI-USE-LOG.md. All assigned paths come from docs/tdd/E04.md:582 section 13. No extra initializers or speculative abstractions. Return missing bindings to the coordinator; a pending proposal is not a contract and a disabled feature is not completed acceptance.

Use SYSTEM 5.1 IdFactory; 5.2 Clock, TimeInput, NormalizedTime and ClockCorrections; 5.3 MissionClock; 5.4 Quantity/Unit/UnitRegistry; 5.5 ProblemError, FieldError, StorageUnavailable and generated ErrorEnvelope; 5.6 snapshot-bound ReleaseHandle/ConfigReleaseReader/ConfigReader, ReleaseCheck and Finding; 5.7 StorageSession, UnitOfWorkFactory, ReadSnapshotFactory, SessionContext, domain events and mandatory audiences; 5.8 full CommandIdentity, IdempotencyStore, ResultVisibility and CommandReceipts; 5.9 reference-only hash-chained audit; 5.10 through 5.10.2 shared scheduler/tasks/EvaluationIsolation; 5.11 HubSettings/SettingSpec; 5.12 ModuleRegistry. Never implement replacements. SYSTEM 6.2 through 6.5 require uv --project hub, pnpm, generated effective types, base/overlay SHA checks and automatic import contracts. Cross-module imports end at application.ports. SYSTEM 8.1, 8.3, 8.4 and 8.6 fix seams, field/purpose privacy, authority and durability; 9/10 fix E01/E02/E03/E23/E15-core dependencies and crew_health.kernel.testing. Use only published provider protocols and those kernel fakes for component tests until providers exist. No invented local Answer DTO, Episode port, clock, queue, ledger, transaction, migration runner or production fake.

Write tests first with e04 and each exact T-E04 ID below, traced to docs/tdd/E04.md:505 and :562 and the corresponding R/V/D or I invariant. Read the applicable must/never/only/always clauses in docs/product/CONTRACTS.md and trace them. Configuration/explicit fixtures supply content, independent source checks supply golden expectations; no medical assertion derives its expected result from the same table used as its input. Fixtures are explicitly selected test/demo inputs, never production fallback data. Unit/integration tests use injected clocks/IDs, no network/devices/wall clock; property-test every parser/rule/conversion. Test zero, negative, empty, maximum, changed units, nullability and all applicable origin modes. Every module proves a scratch label/purpose edit changes content without changing a safety mapping.

AGENTS section 6 applies: operation/target/semantic parameters/body all bind identity; reauthorize stored results; logs/cache/error bodies hold no private text. A delayed event never replaces newer state. Preserve observed time and open-work pins, reject invalid activation and keep last good. Missing role/audience/field/purpose/eligibility denies. No inferred absence, fabricated value, erased disagreement, model safety mutation or sample fallback. Bound every page/loop/call/cache/retry by E04 11 and shared settings. Only EvaluatorComputationFailure is isolated; storage/I/O/integrity/auth/config/input errors abort. English only, no em/en dash or spaced hyphen dash.

Run every listed gate. Missing tooling/providers, zero collected tests, skips, xfails or an unimplemented positive acceptance are not passes. Done requires the complete assigned behavior, tests and lint/type/import gates, plus an interface/evidence handoff with remaining blockers explicit. Full epic completion requires T5, per-module branch coverage >=95%, full safety-condition coverage, complexity <=15, all non-equivalent critical mutants killed, independent build review, CI and coordinator AI-use rows. PLAN Requests assigns shared gate work; never invent a passing local substitute.

Build E04 sections 3/3.1, 8/8.1 and 11: the pure intake policies, immutable catalog and bounded adapter loading, not application persistence (T2), HTTP/registration (T3), UI (T4) or end-to-end orchestration (T5). Freeze the E04-local policy interface for T2. Types copied from E04 3 at docs/tdd/E04.md:124 are IntakeCatalog, Route, QuestionPlan and ChainRow. Route carries nullable module ID, basis pending/answer/fallback/conflict and nullable area-answer reference; QuestionPlan carries ordered eligible/next/not-answered IDs and red_flags_complete. ChainRow is only the section-5 index description, never an Answer copy. Use generated pure enums through kernel mappings, never Pydantic/framework imports in domain. catalog_source maps validated generated documents into pure values. Do not invent shared append types while R-E04-11 is open.

Prerequisites: E01's real kernel/testing and generated effective schema, R-E04-1/5 accepted and delivered by E01/E03 before positive extended-catalog acceptance. Existing base questionnaires has no intake/module/text/classification fields; never parse the pending extension as if approved. Read questionnaires.json, ui-copy.json, responder-flows.json and environment-profiles.json via SYSTEM 5.6, plus exact retained assessment-families.json/input-dictionary.json reference hashes. No runtime reads from docs/product. SourceRegistryPort.resolve_many(source_ids, extra=()) and ConditionRegistryPort.condition_status are E10 4.1; consume their canonical application exports or E01's complete offline equivalents under SYSTEM 5.12, never require an embedding/model server. Missing source/hash/purpose/applicability fails closed; lack of clinical sign-off only displays the Part A label.

Implement I1 through I10 and I-C1 through I-C8 exactly (E04 3/8). Required pinned red flags are unconditional, before area/shared/relevant module questions, with stable first-occurrence deduplication. Blank remains unanswered; unknown/declined area routes to the single fallback; present configured choice routes to its module; absent/invalid route rejects; conflicting heads do not select a winner. New eligibility uses current environment, authorized field/purpose and configured ask_if. Separate hidden historical correction eligibility from new/assistant question eligibility. Relevant restricted anatomy/pregnancy questions may appear for urinary complaints with purpose/decline; unrelated restricted fields stay hidden. Every question/component needs dictionary classification/provenance; missing historical metadata denies, never defaults clinical. Reject private_journal mapping. Validate finite integer scales, nonnegative duration Quantity with exact UCUM, bounded text and kind-specific null/choice semantics; no default inputs or heuristic units. Region default applies only when omitted; explicit null remains null; laterality requires region; band/unknown regions reject. No narrative inference or conversion of self-report into confirmed measurements.

Use SYSTEM 5.2 for original onset/answer time, precision exact/hour/day/unknown, unknown at=null, omitted onset mapped to the existing unknown object. Future/clock-ahead captures remain uncertain rather than rejected/clamped; causal supersession/commit order wins over receipt time. Pure supersession validation checks current same-patient/episode/question head and retains competing accepted branches. No clock normalization implementation here.

Author E04's complete section-8 forms through the existing R-E04-5 handoff to E03, without editing config/questionnaires.json. In golden/family-capture.json deliver the per-family capture manifest and independently checked route/missing-data cases requested in docs/requests/E04.md:85, with question/component references, answer kind/unit, purpose/relevance, unknown/declined behavior and source passage/hash. Supply reviewable exact question-definition content to the coordinator/E03 through that manifest handoff after the schema is settled; it is not a runtime configuration loader or an alternate release. Independently checked expectations must have actual reviewer evidence, never self-attributed checked_by or membership-only coverage. E03 alone incorporates runtime content. Missing authored forms, reference retention or source checking blocks T-E04-060. Include the existing E11 request-6 persistent-palpitations choice without guessing a duration or changing urgent mappings.

Tests first: test_domain.py owns T-E04-001/002/003/010/011/012/013/014/021/031/032/033/041 (R04/R05/R06/R07, V12/V14/V15/V17, I1-I9), property-testing all parsers, route totality, bounded planning, supersession and clock-policy cases. test_catalog.py owns T-E04-060/061/062/063/064/100 (E04-02,R20/R43,I3/I9): each family has usable optional components and independent goldens; all kinds including red flags preserve unknown/declined; every malformed I-C candidate produces a pointer and retains last good; changed/removed/rollback pins retain exact definitions; unavailable historical metadata never falls back. T-E04-100 edits label/purpose only. Unit cases cannot replace T2 activation/HTTP proofs or T5 scenario journeys. conftest/builders contain only bounded config/kernel fixtures, no future T2 imports or mock composed app, so they remain usable before T2 exists. Applicable faults: corrupt/missing/oversized config, partial/nonfinite/wrong-unit input, divergent correction heads, clock jumps/equal raw times in different segments/day boundary, authorization omissions and optional-provider absence. No storage or queue mechanism here. Done requires all domain/catalog tests, gates, reviewed family handoff and exact pure-policy interface; unaccepted content cannot satisfy acceptance.

Build E04 sections 2, 4, 5, 8.1 and 10/11 application/storage behavior. Reuse T1 policy, leaving HTTP/module assembly to T3, Vue to T4 and acceptance journeys to T5. No E15 episode, E01 record, E02 grant or E22 completion implementation. Hard hold: R-E04-7/11 and E02 field/purpose binding must supply canonical EpisodePort/NewEpisode/EpisodeRef/EpisodeFact and AnswerQuery/append input/result/AnswerAccepted through provider application.ports. SYSTEM 8.1 supersedes EpisodeKernel, Session/Viewer and unbounded AnswerStore signatures in E15 4.2 (docs/tdd/E15.md:389). Do not invent fields, a compatibility adapter, an append/dispatch protocol or a paged rebuild checkpoint. Kernel fakes are allowed only for established protocols in isolated component tests; E01/E02/E03/E23/E15-core must be real for T5 acceptance.

Export IntakeQueries.allowed_question_ids(uow: UnitOfWork, episode_id: str)->frozenset[str] and next_question_ids(uow: UnitOfWork, episode_id: str)->tuple[str,...] exactly E04 2 at docs/tdd/E04.md:103. Implement E15's consumer protocols QuestionSensitivity.is_restricted(questionnaire_version: str, question_id: str)->bool and IntakeGaps.not_answered(uow: UnitOfWork, episode_id: str)->tuple[str,...] from docs/tdd/E15.md:453. Missing classification must fail before a boolean can authorize disclosure. bridge binds these protocols without a factory cycle. AnswerConcern is the sole authenticated human write path for later E13 integration after R-E04-9; do not implement its obsolete choice-only EpisodeAnswerPort. MissionStatePort.current uses the caller snapshot and MissionFacts from E23 4.2 (docs/tdd/E23.md:424), not an active_environment_id attribute guessed from an old design. ConsentQueries.allows uses E02 section 2 keyword names and its accepted object/field/purpose result binding, never an officer blanket grant.

Implement StartConcern/startEpisode, AnswerConcern/answerEpisode, GetIntakePlan/history and Rebuild chain in the section-4 order. Authorization precedes identity lookup, which precedes mutable preconditions and repeats inside the writer. Command identity binds actor, operation, normalized route/target, semantic pin/origin parameters and keyed body fingerprint; never persist clinical text in generic receipts/cache. ResultVisibility rechecks current fields before replay; post-cache D6 accepted_command is exact and never reexecutes. StartConcern calls E15-core create in caller UoW, stores intake pin metadata, provider-owned completion intent, audit/replication and receipt. E15 alone owns public concern/onset/revision/completion. For answers validate pin/current eligible or authorized historical correction/value/region/head, append through E01 without premature dispatch, prepare chain and E15 route, then let E01 publish AnswerAccepted once. Mandatory E15 attachment precedes isolated derived computations. No E04 public event or direct urgency/participation write.

SYSTEM 5.10.2 alone catches EvaluatorComputationFailure: preserve valid answer, original release/observation time and durable pending marker/retry/fault audit in one UoW, leave prior urgency/warnings unchanged and expose only existing Health.status degradation. Marker/audit/replication/ledger/commit/storage/I/O/integrity/auth/config/input failures roll back everything. Retry old input cannot clear newer state; permanent computation exhaustion stays pending and visible. Model continuation is postcommit durable E13 work; missing red flags or pending safety evaluation never permits inference. No network/model/ground call while holding the writer.

Owned STRICT tables are exactly E04 section 5 at docs/tdd/E04.md:238: intake_concern (episode_id PK, patient_id, mission_id, origin_mode, home_node_id, config_release_id, questionnaire_version, families_version, dictionary_version, required_red_flag_ids, active_chain_generation) and intake_chain (generation, answer_id, episode_id, question_id, nullable supersedes, commit/causal reference, branch status, is_head, nullable historical release reference; PK generation/answer_id and the two documented indexes). No narrative/onset/value/presence duplicate. StorageSession accesses these tables only; additive 0001_intake.sql uses shared migrations/backup, never drops provider tables or accepted data. All owned mutations declare reference-only local ReplicationChange with export_projection=None. No intake replica registration or authoritative writes from imported projections.

Authoritative correction is home-node/current-head checked in one writer; concurrent stale correction gets INVALID_VALUE /supersedes, current_state null. Rebuild uses the agreed R-E04-11 stable source checkpoint and bounded parent-first staging through shared internal TaskQueue/TaskRunner, never a public Job kind. Retain duplicate-identical facts, missing-parent pending state and competing branches; same-ID/different-payload or cycles are integrity faults. Publish one complete validated generation atomically; changed checkpoint reconciles before publication. Conflict suppresses routing/guidance, clears no safety state and exposes only authorized branches. No timestamp/HLC winner, destructive unique successor or invented conflict-resolution endpoint. Rebuild publication remains off until the shared agreement exists, and its positive tests remain required.

Use all E04 11 bounds, bounded snapshot histories/heads and E01 execution cancellation/watchdog binding, not busy_timeout alone. Open work and corrections keep original definitions. Base Config-Release active mismatch still rejects without recording; R-E04-10 alone can authorize historical-pin exception after approval/generation. Never re-key/relabel a rejected command or fall back to active definitions. R-E04-12 gates area-only transaction and original capture provenance; no fabricated narrative. S5.2 original/received/entered/normalization provenance is retained through the accepted provider types. Absolute onset/consent expiry does not shift; elapsed retries/leases use shared corrections. Audit names intake.concern_started, intake.answer_recorded, intake.command_refused from E04 10 carry only opaque refs/outcome codes, no question/presence/area/module/flow/region/text/counts.

Tests first: test_commands.py owns T-E04-003/011/014/020/022/023/030/031/041/043/064/099 (E04-01/03,R04/R05/R06/R07/R25,V14/V16/V17/V43,I5-I7): unchanged old revisions, original times, reroute plus historical correction, two clients, duplicate/changed target/body/pin, grant filtering, onset unknown and activation removal/rollback. Concern/update completion is exactly once through E15/E22 with original mission-day semantics, independent of outcomes/private text. test_faults.py owns T-E04-044/065/066 (R25,V35,D13): kill before/after append/link/route/attachment/audit/replication/ledger/commit/response; reopen real temporary SQLite and assert all-or-none plus retry. Inject typed computation and every forbidden failure class, disk-full/marker/audit/commit errors, exhausted retries, restart, late older success, child-before-parent/clock-regressed/duplicate/divergent/checkpoint-changed rebuild. Use documented shared fault controls, never production test branches or replacement hub services. test_privacy.py owns T-E04-042/070/071 (R02/R20/R28,V25/V26,I9/I10): owner and narrow-field positive grants, other crew/officer/acting/helper/station denied, no journal/private-report or reconstructable symptom telemetry, no hidden/historical assistant IDs or implicit human write. T5 proves these across the composed HTTP/browser/export/event boundaries. Cover all AGENTS 6 failures including absent/incapacitated subject, prolonged outage and disagreeing input; do not forge self-report. Done requires complete durable/query behavior and tests, no unaccepted local seam, and a frozen application handoff to T3.
